# `csharp_new_line_before_else`

Put else on its own line rather than joining it to the preceding brace.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `true`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `csharp_new_line_before_else = true`

```ini
csharp_new_line_before_else = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Classify(int n)
    {
        if (n > 0) {
            return "positive";
        } else if (n < 0) {
            return "negative";
        } else {
            return "zero";
        }
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Classify(int n)
    {
        if (n > 0)
        {
            return "positive";
        }
        else if (n < 0)
        {
            return "negative";
        }
        else
        {
            return "zero";
        }
    }
}
```
:::

::::
